description: This line plot illustrates the Macro-F1 Score (%) as a function of the Number of tokens, comparing two approaches: “MATTER (ours)” and “w/o material information”. The x-axis, labeled “Number of tokens”, ranges from approximately 0.6 to 1.4 and is presented on a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis, labeled “Macro-F1 Score (%)”, ranges from 48% to 58% and is also on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 2%. The “MATTER (ours)” approach is represented by a solid red line with circular markers, starting at approximately 55.2% at 0.6 tokens, rising to a peak of 58% at 1.0 token, then declining to about 50.8% at 1.4 tokens. The “w/o material information” approach is represented by a solid purple line with circular markers, starting at approximately 52.2% at 0.6 tokens, remaining relatively flat around 52% until 1.2 tokens, then dropping sharply to 48% at 1.4 tokens. Both lines are accompanied by shaded regions indicating variability or confidence intervals, with the red region being lighter pink and the purple region being light lavender.
